thread:
alex: Heads up — we need 4 extra standby slots for a night demo tonight (23:00 UTC). Hybrid mix: 2 A100 + 2 H100. Vendor said they might hold slots if we confirm, but no PO yet. Anyone able to confirm ETA or bump quota? @mira

mira: looping procurement. I have a vendor reply: 'soft-hold until invoice release, expected by EOD PT'. Filing PO now, should have clearer by ~18:30 PT.

sam: finance needs PO number to clear. If you can paste estimated cost I can try to fast-track the approval.

alex: cost estimate ~ $120/hr total (approx $30/A100, $60/H100) for the 4 slots. If that helps.

alex: here's the minimal terraform snippet I was going to apply for the standby carve (will wait for PO):

```hcl
resource "vendor_slot" "night_demo" {
  count = 4
  sku   = "A100" # update 2 -> H100 for the two H100s later
  tenancy = "standby"
  tags = { team = "demo" }
}
```

jordan: can we fall back to preemptible spots if the PO doesn't clear? interactive demo might suffer, but smoke tests OK.

mira: vendor confirmed we have 2 preemptible warm slots in the same region as a fallback. So worst-case we have 2 dedicated + 2 preemptible.

procurement-bot: PO draft created: PO-8821, awaiting finance approval. Link: https://invoices.internal/PO-8821

sam: I pushed approval note on PO-8821, finance flag set to "expedite". If vendor accepts the PO today they can release hold.

eng-prod-bot: deploy scheduled: night-demo-canary -> target infra @ 23:10 UTC (auto-rollout enabled).

alex: thanks. I'll hold on applying the terraform until procurement confirms. I'll also rerun the canary PR after PO is clear. @mira please ping here once PO is final and vendor accepts. :thumbsup:

mira: will do. if anything changes I'll update this thread.

alex: quick note — if PO delayed past 20:30 PT we should flip plan: 2 H100 -> 2 preemptible H100 + 2 preemptible A100 and delay interactive demo. Who wants to own that rollback if it happens?

jordan: I can own the rollback plan and the config toggles.

alex: awesome. thanks everyone.
